about: Per-jurisdiction QC baseline screens, as data (review-audit draft 12). baselineRules.ts reads these records with ONE generic rule and names no state, city or utility. A STATE record (ahj empty) applies to a job whose state is `state`, or, when the job has no state, whose AHJ contains one of `ahjNames` (lower-case, substring). A CITY record (ahj set) applies inside its state record's jurisdiction when the AHJ contains one of its `ahjNames`. `prescriptive.defaults` are the limits screened when the caller passes no code context (qc.ts always passes one, from jurisdiction_code_profiles); `prescriptive.publishesPath` says the jurisdiction publishes a prescriptive rooftop-PV path, so the screens run on whatever limits the context carries; `prescriptive.ruleIds` and `exportScreen` keep the rule ids and words QC history, blocker gating and the goldens key on. `screens` are checks by KIND (code reads the package per kind; the words are here). Severity follows the Helm #637 bar: a screen asks for `severity: blocker` and blocks only with a verbatim `quote` and a named `source` (or a person's / official row); otherwise it warns. Every shipped screen warns. Overlaid per ruleId by state_permit_rules rows of family `qc` (a person's or an official read). Catalogue entries for the `rules` table are in `ruleDefinitions`, in catalogue order.

exportScreen.message: Generation/export may exceed Tier 1 screens ({dcKw} kW DC{combinedNote} / {exportKw} kW export). Confirm Tier 2/3 utility path.

screens.message: AC/manual disconnect requirement was not clearly identified. Confirm lockable load-break disconnect or documented utility exception.

ruleDefinitions.name: Oregon Tier 1 export screen
ruleDefinitions.trigger: Export capacity over 25 kW or generation over 50 kW
ruleDefinitions.action: Flag likely Tier 2/3 utility review path before submission.

ruleDefinitions.name: Oregon NEM manual disconnect
ruleDefinitions.action: Confirm lockable load-break disconnect or documented utility exception.

ruleDefinitions.name: Oregon prescriptive snow limit
ruleDefinitions.trigger: Ground snow load over 70 psf or missing
ruleDefinitions.action: Route to engineered path or human structural review.

ruleDefinitions.name: Oregon prescriptive dead load limit
ruleDefinitions.trigger: PV system dead load over 4.5 psf or missing
ruleDefinitions.action: Route to engineered path or verify stamped structural basis.

ruleDefinitions.name: Oregon prescriptive roof framing
ruleDefinitions.trigger: Rafter/truss spacing missing or over 24 inches
ruleDefinitions.action: Require engineered path or verified framing exception.

ruleDefinitions.name: Oregon PV firefighter pathways
ruleDefinitions.source: Oregon BCD PV Pathways Technical Bulletin
ruleDefinitions.trigger: Rooftop PV with no pathway/site plan evidence
ruleDefinitions.action: Confirm site plan shows required firefighter access and escape pathways.

ruleDefinitions.name: Portland solar submittal documents
ruleDefinitions.action: Flag missing plan sheets before DevHub submission.

ruleDefinitions.name: Portland ready for issue status
ruleDefinitions.trigger: Pre-issuance complete / ready to issue / fees due
ruleDefinitions.action: Flag ready_for_issue and queue human fee/payment/download step.
